\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 158-161 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R166-first-pass-words-from-chapters-158-161}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for cash and a blouse.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item if, but, because of, a result, a problem
  \item anyway, without, otherwise, while, especially
  \item a motive, a meaning, an intention, an event, luck
  \item tasty, cool, raw, tight, loose
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
If? (\textbf{\fa{اگر}}, \emph{agar}.) But? (\textbf{\fa{ولی}}, \emph{vali}.) Because of? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{خاطر}}, \emph{be khâter-e}.) A result? (\textbf{\fa{نتیجه}}, \emph{natije}.) A problem? (\textbf{\fa{مشکل}}, \emph{moshkel}.) Anyway? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{هر} \fa{حال}}, \emph{be har hâl}.) Without? (\textbf{\fa{بدون}}, \emph{bedun-e}.) Otherwise? (\textbf{\fa{وگرنه}}, \emph{vagarna}.) While? (\textbf{\fa{در} \fa{حالی} \fa{که}}, \emph{dar hâli ke}.) Especially? (\textbf{\fa{مخصوصا}}, \emph{makhsusan}.) A motive? (\textbf{\fa{انگیزه}}, \emph{angize}.) A meaning? (\textbf{\fa{منظور}}, \emph{manzur}.) An intention? (\textbf{\fa{قصد}}, \emph{qasd}.) An event? (\textbf{\fa{اتفاق}}, \emph{ettefâq}.) Luck? (\textbf{\fa{شانس}}, \emph{shâns}.) Tasty? (\textbf{\fa{خوشمزه}}, \emph{khoshmaze}.) Cool? (\textbf{\fa{خنک}}, \emph{khonak}.) Raw? (\textbf{\fa{خام}}, \emph{khâm}.) Tight? (\textbf{\fa{تنگ}}, \emph{tang}.) Loose? (\textbf{\fa{گشاد}}, \emph{goshâd}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{\fa{خراب}}, \emph{kharâb}.) Different? (\textbf{\fa{مختلف}}, \emph{mokhtalef}.) Better? (\textbf{\fa{بهتر}}, \emph{behtar}.) Successful? (\textbf{\fa{موفق}}, \emph{movaffaq}.) Blunt?
